newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech sees 96 net weighed down by tax.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech sees 96 net weighed down by tax.

text.p: Austrian engineering group VA Technologie said on Wednesday it expected net profit for the full year to be weighed down by an increased tax burden.

"For 1996 as a whole, the profit from ordinary activities, order intake, turnover....should again show substantial, continuous growth. The net profit will be burdened by higher taxes due to the postponed use of tax loss carry forwards," VA Tech said in a statement ahead of its earnings conference.
The government scrapped tax credits on losses carried forward in 1996 and 1997.

VA Tech earlier said group net profit for the first six months jumped 29 percent to 378 million schillings as sales climbed 32 percent to 12.2 billion schillings and pre-tax profit jumped 50 percent to 484 million schillings. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
